notes:
- Product: JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) that ships a local Rust indexer + language-aware completion layer.
- Key ask: low-latency streaming completions for in-editor suggestions (target median <50ms, p95 <120ms), per-workspace model pinning, local repo indexing so source code never leaves dev machine by default.
- Security: want hybrid: embeddings/hashes sent to hosted only if explicit user opt-in; prefer Redwood Private or VPC with a lightweight local agent that handles indexing & cache. Must have SOC2, audit logs, KMS support and EU data residency option.
- Business: PLG + enterprise upsell; paying customers likely through seat licenses + dedicated inference for teams. ARR target for first yr with Redwood ~ $75k.
- Quote from Anna (CTO): "We need completions that feel native — latency and consistency matter more than fancy model bells. If we can keep indexing local and still get the routing/fallback benefits, that's huge."
- Technical constraints: plugin runs in user's JVM process; pref for HTTP/Unix-socket agent; need small memory footprint (<250MB for local agent), support for streaming token chunks to UI, and offline mode where completions degrade gracefully.
- Model preferences: prefer open Llama-family variants for on-prem testing; want pinning per workspace and automated rollback on quality regressions.
- Cost sensitivity: engineering teams price-sensitive; want Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to reduce per-token cost.
- POC plan: 6-week evaluation. Week 1: install staging agent + sample projects. Week 2-3: latency & correctness benchmarks (editor hook). Week 4: security questionnaire + DPA. Week 5: pilot with 10 internal devs. Week 6: decision + procurement.
- Current ask from AE: provide architecture diagram for hybrid agent + Private control plane, draft DPA + SOC2 evidence, and perf baseline with model-variant A/B.
- Backchannel: legal wants standard DPA + data residency addendum. Engineering wants a small test token quota and a downloadable private agent package.
- Notes shorthand: evaling Redwood Private + hosted fallback; SE to demo local agent install in PyCharm; follow-up call 2026-03-15 to review security pack.
